objective: Extend the original economics laboratory with interactive, editable demand/supply elasticity lessons and the supplied revenue, linear-demand, wheat and oil examples; keep explanations from covering cards.
scope: Five demand and supply cases, midpoint elasticity, zero/undefined/infinite cases, editable revenue comparisons and non-overlapping gained/lost revenue areas.
Linear demand table and selectable arcs, separate point elasticity, exact maximum-revenue chart and income/cross elasticity.
Editable wheat supply increase and oil short/long-run supply reduction with equal horizontal shifts and shared axes.
Keep explanations in document flow below each chart; independent accessible descriptions and collision-aware point labels, keyboard, mouse and touch.
Retain the original design, local persistence, saved old exercises, hidden results and all existing subject/exam behavior; add mathematical and browser regressions.
restrictions: No push, merge, deployment, credentials, database operations or changes outside this worktree.
Synthetic public evidence only; one implementer, no edits while Claude reviews; initial review plus at most three correction rounds.
No new dependencies or remote content-generation services; preserve the separate collaborative application and its data.
